meta.name: ecommerce-seo-audit
meta.description: Comprehensive ecommerce SEO audit for product pages, collection pages, technical SEO, log file analysis, and competitor research. Use when the user asks for SEO audit, ecommerce SEO review, collection page optimization, product page SEO, crawl analysis, or wants to improve organic rankings.

copy.tagline: 分析电商网站SEO表现并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营电商网站并希望提升自然搜索流量。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze ecommerce SEO performance and get optimization suggestions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an ecommerce site and want to improve organic search traffic.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个电商 SEO 审计专家。它能分析你提供的产品页、分类页、技术 SEO 元素（如 robots.txt、站点地图、Schema 标记），以及日志文件或爬取数据，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当你要求进行 SEO 审计、电商 SEO 审查、分类页优化、产品页 SEO、爬取分析，或想提升自然排名时触发。

say.text: 分析一下我的分类页 /collections/shoes 的优化情况。
say.note: Claude 会检查分类页的内容、内部链接和关键词覆盖。

say.text: 对比我的网站和竞争对手在关键词“running shoes”上的表现。
say.note: Claude 会分析前5名竞争对手的页面并给出对比。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an ecommerce SEO audit expert. It can analyze product pages, collection pages, technical SEO elements (robots.txt, sitemaps, schema), log files, or crawl data you provide, and give optimization recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for an SEO audit, ecommerce SEO review, collection page optimization, product page SEO, crawl analysis, or want to improve organic rankings.

say_en.text: Audit the SEO of this product page: https://example.com/product/123
say_en.note: Claude will analyze title, description, H1, schema, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze the optimization of my collection page /collections/shoes.
say_en.note: Claude will check content, internal links, and keyword coverage.

say_en.text: Compare my site with competitors for keyword 'running shoes'.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze top 5 competitor pages and give comparison.
